correctness.rationale: The conditional-edge argument correctly separates crossing partners (d−1)(2n−d−1) from nesting partners binom(d−1,2)+(i−1)(2n−j), each divided by 2n−3. Summing over candidate edges of weight min(d−1,2n−d−1), with W=n(n−1)² and explicit U_X,U_N, gives the claimed exact covariances for every integer n≥2. Var(S) uses inclusion probabilities for disjoint and incident edges, while Var(X)=Var(N) follows from pair-count involution. Separate independent exact Fraction enumeration of all matchings for n=2,3,4,5 reproduced (Cov(S,X),Cov(S,N))=(4/9,−2/9),(6/5,−2/5),(96/35,−24/35),(1000/189,−200/189), verifying −n ratio; finite checks do not prove full n-range. The original verify.py and its 2≤n≤7 exhaustive and n≤200 weighted checks were inspected as additional reproducibility, not accepted only from logs.
